text: Valeria, a young woodworker in Mexico, is overjoyed to learn she is [pregnant with her first child|who_suffers|expectant parents], and begins to crack her knuckles without thinking. One night she watches a woman in the building opposite leap from a balcony and rise again, [bones cracking, with no eyes or mouth|images|ghosts and strange figures]. The visions follow her into her sister's house and to the crib she built, which bursts into flames, and her aunt takes her to [a curandera who knows another, more dangerous way|rules|faith and charms protect].
